description: CLEANUP-MS0/U-CLEANUP-B9 — frozen model-drift eval corpus for the golf peer-commit reviewer. 10 known-bug commits with operator-verified verdicts. The weekly cron (32-golf-reviewer-drift-eval.ps1) runs the reviewer against these and tracks accuracy in accuracy-history.jsonl. SEEDING: replace each placeholder commitSha ("") with a real historical commit SHA from this repo whose verdict is independently known; until seeded, the cron reports corpus_unseeded and never pollutes the accuracy trend. expectedVerdict in {bug,clean,needs-review}; expectedSeverity in {P0,P1,P2,P3,none}. promptVersion lets the suite flag prompt drift separately from model drift.

entries.description: A commit that inlined a Kienzle kc1.1 constant instead of importing from src/physics/constants.ts — the reviewer must catch this as a P0 (safety-critical: a drifted constant scraps parts).
A commit that shipped a stub engine returning a hardcoded placeholder — reviewer must catch as P0 (comprehensive-build-enforce violation).
A new engine committed without dispatcher wiring (no import + action enum + schema) — reviewer must catch as P1.
A commit that weakened a real assertion to toBeDefined() to make a test green — reviewer must catch as P1.
A commit with a magic number that should be a named constant — reviewer should flag as P2.
A commit whose function lacks a documented edge-case guard (empty/null) — reviewer should flag as P2.
A commit whose JSDoc no longer matches the function signature — reviewer should flag as P3.
A clean, behavior-preserving refactor with tests intact — reviewer must NOT flag a false positive (verdict=clean).
A documentation-only commit — reviewer must return clean (no false positive on prose changes).
A commit touching a physics formula whose correctness depends on context the diff alone can't establish — reviewer should return needs-review (escalate, don't guess).
